en_title: Is Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Really the End of the Rebooted Modern Warfare Story? Infinity Ward Responds
cn_title: 《《使命召唤：现代战争4》》《现代战争4》是终章？IW回应
subtitle: 「你不会喜欢这个答案」
opus_summary: 《使命召唤：现代战争4》是否为重启故事的终章？叙事总监Jeff Negus表示自己也不知道，但团队力求收束故事、回应悬念。他还透露，2019年时并未制定长期剧情规划。

paragraphs.en: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4’s campaign is available now in early access, and is arguably the strongest the series has been since its 2019 revival . Those who have played it will be aware that a lot of its heroes and villains meet their end in one of the darkest COD entries to date. It makes it all feel like a bow being tied on this particular storyline. Activision has confirmed a new Call of Duty subfranchise outside of the traditional Modern Warfare and Black Ops rotation is in the works, further signalling that it may be the end of this particular road.
paragraphs.cn: 《使命召唤：现代战争4》的战役现已开放抢先体验，可以说是该系列自2019年重启以来最出色的一次。玩过的玩家应该知道，本作是迄今为止基调最黑暗的《使命召唤》作品之一，许多正反派角色都在其中丧命。这让人感觉，这条故事线似乎正在收尾。Activision已确认，正在开发《使命召唤》的一个全新子系列，不属于以往轮流推出的《现代战争》和《黑色行动》系列。这也进一步暗示，这段故事或许已走到终点。

paragraphs.en: But is that Activision’s plan, or if MW4 turns out to be a smash success, will the developer be tempted to head back to Captain Price and gang well one more time? The final mission of the campaign, taking place during the middle of the game’s credits, appears to suggest it might be the end of the line for the saga and one of its most beloved characters . It begs the question: Is this the end of the rebooted Modern Warfare story?
paragraphs.cn: 但Activision真是这样打算的吗？还是说，如果《现代战争4》大获成功，开发团队又会忍不住回到普莱斯上尉和他的伙伴们身上，再讲一次他们的故事？战役的最后一个任务出现在制作人员名单播放期间，似乎暗示这段故事，以及其中一位最受喜爱的角色，或许都已走到终点。这不禁让人想问：重启版《现代战争》的故事就此结束了吗？

paragraphs.en: “It's a good question, and you'll not love the answer,” Jeff Negus, narrative director at Infinity Ward, told IGN.
paragraphs.cn: Infinity Ward叙事总监Jeff Negus告诉IGN：「这是个好问题，但你不会喜欢这个答案。」

paragraphs.en: “I don't know. What I do know is we tried to tell a definitive, conclusive story in that we were trying to set up, or rather pay off the setups, answer things that had been posed as questions, push characters into new territory that they've never been in before, raise the stakes, push the conflict.”
paragraphs.cn: 「我不知道。我能确定的是，我们尝试讲述一个有明确结局、能够收束的故事。我们想要埋下伏笔——或者更准确地说，回收伏笔，解答此前留下的问题，让角色踏入从未涉足的境地，让局势更加严峻，推动冲突发展。」

paragraphs.en: This new era of Modern Warfare started strongly with 2019’s acclaimed campaign that echoed much of what players enjoyed about the 2007 original. Despite the callbacks, the most exciting thing was that it felt like something fresh, with new characters blending in with familiar faces to tell a new story. The recently released MW4 pulls off a similar trick, weaving in a huge-scale Korean conflict with the more personal Price missions. But the path here was rocky, and not necessarily one that was meant to end here. In fact, it turns out there wasn’t really a fleshed-out idea of where the saga would go post-2019.
paragraphs.cn: 《现代战争》的新时代以2019年广受好评的战役强势开局，重现了2007年原作中许多玩家喜爱的元素。尽管有这些呼应，最令人兴奋的还是它带来的新鲜感：新角色与熟悉的面孔一同讲述了一个新故事。最近推出的《现代战争4》也做到了类似的事，将朝鲜半岛的大规模冲突与更聚焦普莱斯个人的任务交织在一起。但走到这里的过程并不平坦，而这里也未必是原定的终点。事实上，团队当时并没有详细想好，2019年之后这段故事该如何发展。

paragraphs.en: “No, there wasn't a long-term plan”, Negus revealed. “Similar to a television show where you got a first season, it comes out, people like it, cool, there's going to be another one. If you do it well, what you built can be built upon in a way where you can use it as a foundation and then push on top of that to build and go to new places.
paragraphs.cn: Negus透露：「没有，当时没有长期规划。这就像一部电视剧，第一季播出了，观众喜欢，那很好，就会有下一季。如果做得好，你已经建立起来的东西就能成为基础，让你在上面继续搭建，探索新的方向。」

paragraphs.en: “Four, that was of particular importance for us. Not many games get a four, let alone one that has these kinds of characters that have gone through the things they've gone through. And so while there wasn't a long-term plan necessarily for the story specifically from 2019, we definitely are self-reflexive in a way where we're looking back at the same time as being in the present in order to inform it and make it more impactful.”
paragraphs.cn: 「第四部对我们来说尤其重要。能出到第四部的游戏并不多，更何况还有这样一群经历过这么多事情的角色。所以，尽管从2019年起，我们并没有专门为故事制定长期规划，但我们确实一直在回顾和反思。在着眼当下的同时，我们也会回看过去，以此指引现在的故事，让它更有感染力。」

paragraphs.en: Having the plot of a four-game series being developed over the course of much of the decade not entirely mapped out is understandable, but what may be surprising is that the team didn’t know where this story would be heading just three years ago after the release of Modern Warfare 3.
paragraphs.cn: 一个横跨近十年开发、包含四部游戏的系列，没有事先完整规划好剧情，这可以理解。但或许让人意外的是，就在三年前《现代战争3》发售后，团队也还不知道这个故事会走向何方。

paragraphs.en: “It's interesting because at the end of Modern Warfare 3, there were some definitive events that took place,” Negus explained. “And because of that, particularly for Price, once you take that action, you can't come back from it. And although it doesn't change his core motivations, and in that I don't think it changes his character, it does adjust how he tries to achieve his goals; the means changed. And we weren't beholden to it, but we wanted to use it as a way to continue the story in a meaningful way, not go, ‘Don't worry about that thing that happened,’ but really lean into it and say, ‘Well, if he had done that, it would mean this. And if it meant this, how can we use that to push into new territory?’ And that's where an alliance between Price and Valeria comes in.”
paragraphs.cn: Negus解释道：「有意思的是，《现代战争3》结尾发生了一些具有决定性意义的事件。因此，尤其对普莱斯来说，一旦采取了那样的行动，就没有回头路了。虽然这没有改变他的核心动机——从这一点来说，我认为他的性格并没有变——但确实改变了他实现目标的方式；手段变了。我们并没有被这件事束缚住，但希望借此让故事有意义地延续下去，而不是让大家别在意发生过的那件事。我们想真正深入探讨：如果他做了那件事，会意味着什么？如果意味着这样的结果，我们又能如何借此探索新的方向？普莱斯与Valeria的结盟就是由此而来的。」

paragraphs.en: There’s a lot going on in Modern Warfare 4’s story, and it's a credit to Negus and the team that it remains coherent throughout, despite having to juggle an extensive cast dotted around much of the globe. It’s a stark contrast to MW3’s limited, plot-light campaign, which introduced fan-favourite villain Makarov in what felt like a rushed manner.
paragraphs.cn: 《现代战争4》的故事内容相当丰富，尽管需要兼顾分散在全球各地的大批角色，剧情始终保持连贯，这要归功于Negus和团队。相比之下，《现代战争3》的战役篇幅有限、剧情单薄，就连引入深受玩家喜爱的反派马卡洛夫时，也显得有些仓促。

paragraphs.en: The development time granted to Infinity Ward to construct it was truncated, especially when compared to the three years it had with MW4, and it shows in its quality, but also in its quantity. This is a beefy campaign with a lot of story to tell. So much so that its opening missions almost feel like an epilogue to Modern Warfare 3, as it clears the table ahead of telling its new story. So, in an ideal world, was part of this story ever meant to be in that game from three years ago?
paragraphs.cn: Infinity Ward制作《现代战争3》的时间被压缩了，尤其是与《现代战争4》拥有的三年开发时间相比，两者的差别不仅体现在质量上，也体现在内容量上。《现代战争4》的战役分量十足，有大量故事要讲，以至于开头几个任务几乎像是《现代战争3》的尾声，先处理前作留下的事情，再开始讲述新故事。那么，在理想情况下，这次的部分剧情是否原本应该出现在三年前的那款游戏中？

paragraphs.en: “Short answer, no,” Negus stated. “I think the reason that this story has so much in it is that we had the ambition to continue the legacy character storylines and a very strong impulse to return to form in that, assuming the role of a low-level soldier within a bigger war landscape. And so obviously those characters that we've been with don't really fit that desire in terms of having that perspective. So it was a challenge, but ultimately an opportunity to get to redefine our returning characters and define, for the first time, a whole set of new, young, fresh faces that would give us a totally different perspective. And we combined them together, uniting them by a common theme continuing from 2019, setting up the ‘you draw the line wherever you need it’ that permeates both threads of the storyline and both perspectives.”
paragraphs.cn: Negus表示：「简单说，没有。我认为，这次故事之所以有这么多内容，是因为我们既想延续老角色的故事线，又非常希望回归以往的形式，让玩家在一场更大规模的战争中扮演基层士兵。显然，一直陪伴我们的那些角色，并不太适合提供我们想要的这种视角。所以，这既是挑战，最终也是一次机会，让我们重新定义回归的角色，同时首次塑造一整批年轻的新面孔，带来完全不同的视角。我们将两者结合起来，用一个从2019年延续至今的共同主题将它们串联起来：你会根据需要决定底线在哪里。这个主题贯穿两条故事线，也贯穿两种视角。」

paragraphs.en: This approach is definitely proving a success, with Modern Warfare 4’s campaign receiving widespread praise from fans, and a thank you from the actor behind Captain Price in return to those enjoying it. Have you played it? Did you enjoy it? Let us know in the comments!
paragraphs.cn: 事实证明，这种做法确实取得了成功。《现代战争4》的战役获得了玩家的广泛好评，普莱斯上尉的饰演者也向喜欢本作的玩家表达了感谢。你玩过了吗？觉得怎么样？欢迎在评论区告诉我们！
